package main

import (
	"encoding/json"
	"fmt"
	"os"

	"go.temporal.io/server/tools/gomad/internal/model/world"
)

func main() {
	if err := run(); err != nil {
		fmt.Fprintln(os.Stderr, err)
		os.Exit(1)
	}
}

func run() error {
	if len(os.Args) != 2 {
		return fmt.Errorf("expected a retained World snapshot")
	}
	raw, err := os.ReadFile(os.Args[1])
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	wrapped, err := world.WrapExpandedSnapshot(raw, world.CompressedSnapshotProfile())
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	snapshot, err := world.DecodeSnapshot(wrapped)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	return json.NewEncoder(os.Stdout).Encode(snapshot)
}
